subject: [hw] DONE V11 rev 2
body:
Rev 2 (self-audit hardening after the DONE; no interface change, no review finding yet).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V11 PASS 956/956
(twice: ASan+UBSan -O1 and plain -O2; ~18 s; /tmp/n2hw-V11 only.)

Changes since rev 1:
1. SMUSDX/SMLSDX/SMLSLDX product order corrected (already reported in the DONE message): p1 = Rn.lo*Rm.hi, p2 = Rn.hi*Rm.lo, result = p1 - p2; 12 test literals fixed plus one SMLSDX overflow/Q case. Arm A32/T32 reference and __smusdx intrinsic doc; D01 added it as FACTS 4.14/4.15.
2. SMULxy/SMULWy now reject [15:12] != 0000 (fixed field) with N2A32_UNDEF instead of executing; two new must-be-UNDEF cases. This supersedes the "UNPREDICTABLE-but-allocated forms execute" item in my DONE not-done list.
3. Test harness now checks r15 unchanged unconditionally (the earlier condition could never fire) and expect_undef also checks thumb/in_it. No implementation change from these two.

Independent evidence, both run just now:
- R1s spot suite (copy of gpu/hwcodec/review/r1/run_spot.sh + spot.c built under /tmp/n2hw-V11, so R1s own /tmp is untouched): R1-SPOT FAIL 178/183, and every failure is v14 (mov pc interworking, cbz/cbnz i=1) or v15 (t32 adc, t32 sadd16). All V11 checks pass, including SMUSD/SMUAD(X)/SMLALBB/SMLAW/SMMUL/SSAT/USAT/SSAT16/USAT16/QADD/SADD16/UQADD16/SEL/PKHBT/PKHTB/REVSH/RBIT.
- T01 differential harness: all k_v11_* kernels pass in arm-O0/O2/O3v/armv8-O3v with 0 mismatches; thumb k_v11_* stops are T32 BL (V16) or the V15 PKH bug. D01 recorded the attribution as FACTS 4.16.

STATUS files updated: gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/STATUS.md and gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V11/STATUS.md. Files otherwise as in the DONE message. Still available for review findings.
